configuration.title: Markdown Studio
configuration.plantuml.mode.description: PlantUML rendering mode. The bundled JAR mode is the default and most complete option.
configuration.java.path.description: Path to the Java executable used for PlantUML rendering.
configuration.security.blockExternalLink: Legacy external resource switch for preview and export.
configuration.security.externalResources: External resource control mode for preview and export.
Domains allowed when external resource mode is set to whitelist.
configuration.export.header.enabled.desc: Enable a PDF header with the document title on each page.
configuration.export.header.template.des: Custom HTML template for the PDF header. Use Playwright CSS classes (pageNumber, totalPages, title, date, url) for dynamic content. When null, the built-in template is used.
configuration.export.footer.enabled.desc: Enable a PDF footer with page numbers on each page.
configuration.export.footer.template.des: Custom HTML template for the PDF footer. Use Playwright CSS classes (pageNumber, totalPages, title, date, url) for dynamic content. When null, the built-in template is used.
configuration.export.pageBreak.enabled.d: Honor CSS page-break-before and page-break-after properties during PDF export.
configuration.export.pdfIndex.enabled.ma: Generate a Table of Contents page with page numbers at the beginning of the PDF.
configuration.export.pdfIndex.title.mark: Title displayed at the top of the PDF index page.
configuration.export.pdfToc.hidden.markd: Hide recognized inline TOC markers in PDF export.
configuration.export.pdfBookmarks.enable: Generate PDF bookmarks (outlines) from headings for PDF viewer sidebar navigation.
configuration.preview.theme.description: Preview theme mode. Auto follows the active VS Code color theme.
configuration.preview.theme.enum.auto: Automatically follow the VS Code color theme.
configuration.preview.theme.enum.light: Always render the preview in light mode.
configuration.preview.theme.enum.dark: Always render the preview in dark mode.
configuration.preview.sourceJump.enabled: Double-click in preview jumps to the corresponding source line.
configuration.style.preset.markdownDescr: Base typography preset for preview and PDF export.
configuration.style.fontFamily.markdownD: Override the preset font family. Takes priority over the preset default, but can be overridden by Theme or Custom CSS.
configuration.style.fontSize.markdownDes: Override the preset font size in pixels (8-32). Takes priority over the preset default, but can be overridden by Theme or Custom CSS.
configuration.style.lineHeight.markdownD: Override the preset line height (1.0-3.0). Takes priority over the preset default, but can be overridden by Theme or Custom CSS.
configuration.style.theme.markdownDescri: Visual theme applied above the style preset.
configuration.style.theme.enum.default: Default - no extra theme; uses preset and individual overrides only.
configuration.style.theme.enum.modern: Modern - Inter/system typography, indigo accents, soft shadows, and rounded corners.
configuration.style.theme.enum.markdownP: Markdown PDF - classic look matching the Markdown PDF extension, with simple borders.
configuration.style.theme.enum.minimal: Minimal - bare-bones, clean starting point for customization.
configuration.style.customCss.markdownDe: Final CSS override layer. Use for small inline tweaks or pasted theme snippets.
configuration.export.margin.description: Page margin for PDF export. Accepts CSS units (mm, cm, in, px).
configuration.toc.levels.description: Heading level range to include in the TOC, for example `1-3` or `2-4`.
configuration.toc.orderedList.descriptio: Generate the TOC as an ordered list.
configuration.toc.pageBreak.description: Insert page breaks around the TOC in PDF export.
configuration.codeBlock.lineNumbers.desc: Show line numbers in code blocks.
configuration.export.diagramTimeout.mark: Diagram rendering timeout in seconds. `0` means no timeout.
configuration.network.caCertificates.des: Additional CA certificate file paths in PEM format, useful for SSL inspection environments such as Zscaler.
